items.prompt: A cancel request was sent for a partly filled order. What can still happen before confirmation?

options.text: The unfilled remainder is guaranteed to vanish immediately
The earlier fills are automatically reversed
options.why: Canceling remainder does not undo fills.

options.text: Additional fills can arrive while cancellation is pending
options.why: Preserve exposure until source events/reconciliation establish the outcome.

options.text: The order becomes a cash deposit

items.explanation: Cancel and execution can cross; do not treat local intent as confirmed state.
